reviews.title: So much potential
reviews.text: If this game had more players and put some money into game development it would be hands down the best trivia game on the App Store. Questions need the ability to add pictures. And there should be a better way to search and sort through community themes. There should also be a way to earn points for each game and a way to see your all time stats.

reviews.title: Angry
reviews.text: Some questions aren’t specific enough for answers. For example one question asked where was the attack of Pearl Harbor? That is a question that could be answered with, the US, hawaii, Oahu, and Pearl Harbor. Yet it only accepts one answer I lost because of this and I’m truly outraged about it. I should have gotten it right but instead I looked like a fool! If I could give it a zero I would! I am disappointed and wouldn’t recommend it to anyone. #karenout
